ownerReports.check: Install the B4 build, switch on the server rules, and use the backup offline for a day
ownerReports.summary: Offline day on 0.5.1: saving as fast as usual with about 150 changes waiting. Airplane mode off: just under 10 s before sending started, about 45 s to send them all, the count decreasing at a steady rate. Throughout and after, Impostazioni showed 'Ora senza connessione' with the warning icon, ending on 'Tutto inviato. Ora senza connessione', although the phone was online and everything was sent; closing and reopening the app showed 'Copia online aggiornata'. Only one copy of the app was open.

ownerReports.check: Update to 0.5.2 and recheck the offline day: the status now follows the uploads
ownerReports.summary: Phone on 0.5.2: update in place fine; a few hours offline with about 200 changes; airplane mode off sent them too fast to count and the status reached Copia online aggiornata by itself; Ora senza connessione went away; a later 40-change comandate recompute shows it for under a second. Step 5 failed on the PC: a new course in desktop Chrome, sign-in, replace with the online copy, and the app stays on Ripristino del corso dal backup online, also after a refresh. Reproduced: the desktop shared sync worker never starts (DataCloneError on the database options).
ownerReports.device: Motorola Edge 60; Windows PC for step 5

ownerReports.check: Update to 0.5.3: the PC finishes its restore and follows the phone
ownerReports.summary: 1: on the PC the app briefly showed another page, closed and reopened by itself very quickly, then opened the course correctly with the correct version. 2: on the phone the update button showed after a couple of seconds and worked flawlessly. 3: a note changed on the phone was on the PC after reopening the screen, fast even on an immediate refresh; no automatic refresh, which is known. 4: the same from the PC to the phone. Nothing odd came up.
ownerReports.device: Motorola Edge 60 and the development PC (the owner's devices in earlier reports; not restated)
ownerReports.browser: Not restated (Chrome on both in earlier reports)
